user.title: Eufy account
user.description: Log in with the same email and password you use in the Eufy Clean app.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Eufy rejected the saved password. Enter it again.

error.invalid_auth: Eufy rejected the login ({details}). Check the email and password you use in the Eufy app. After several wrong passwords Eufy can lock logins for a while.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't finish logging in to Eufy ({details}). Try again in a minute.
error.no_devices: This account has no robots. Make sure the robot is set up in the Eufy Clean app with this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error ({details}). Details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: That robot is already set up.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Send the robot to clean specific rooms, by name or room ID.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names as they appear in the Eufy app, or room IDs.

clean_type.name: Clean type
clean_type.description: Vacuum, mop, or both. Leave empty to use the robot's current setting.

clean_times.name: Passes
clean_times.description: How many times to clean each room.

refresh_rooms.name: Refresh rooms
refresh_rooms.description: Re-read the robot's room list (from the robot over the local network, or from the Eufy cloud).

dock_unreachable.title: Can't reach {name} on your network
dock_unreachable.description: Eufy Clean Rooms reads the room list from the robot over your local network and can't connect to its dock. Make sure Home Assistant and the dock are on the same network, or set the dock's IP address in the integration's options. The last known rooms are still in use.

init.title: Dock address
init.description: The room list is read from the robot over your local network. Normally the dock is found automatically; set its IP address here if Home Assistant can't find it (for example on a different subnet). Leave empty to use discovery.

abort.not_tuya: This robot uses Eufy's MQTT cloud; there is nothing to configure.
